name: Open-Back Lanyard Bumper
summary: An open-back bumper with two lanyard tabs, port access, and separate TPU and short-edge-rib PLA variants.
description: A one-piece bumper with an open screen and back, two top lanyard tabs, and openings for the buttons and ports. The flexible version has a continuous front lip; the experimental PLA version retains only two short-edge ribs and still requires case deflection during insertion. A user-supplied photo shows a printed cover fitted on Sticky; material, print settings and functional checks are not yet recorded.
